semantics.source: Recorded receipts only; source artifacts and pixels are not independently reverified.
semantics.render_event_hz: 1000 / warmup-excluded render interval mean; not frames / elapsed.
semantics.get_fps: Recorded GetFps samples, separate from render-event frequency.
semantics.cpu_native: Per-upload deserialize_ms + combine_ms + attach_ms, then distribution statistics.
semantics.cpu_quantiles: Sorted samples at floor((n-1)*q); no sum of stage percentiles.
semantics.initial_cpu: One initial_snapshot preparation/submission reference; reused datasets may predate this case.
semantics.actual_update_hz: Runtime effective upload/publish counts divided by full measurement elapsed time.
semantics.sustained_dynamic: Successful full-duration scheduler run without truncation or budget stop; pixel correctness is separate.
semantics.pixel_scope: Frozen final generation only; does not establish every generation or every render frame.
semantics.thresholds: Interval counts use strict >33.3 ms and >50 ms.
